entities.description: Became part of New Argive during the Thaw.

entities.name: Ice Age

events.summary: Come the Ice Age, the land froze over and became the Kjeldoran Hinterlands.
events.quote: Come the Ice Age , the land froze over and became known as the Kjeldoran Hinterlands .

events.summary: During the Thaw, the ice melted, Kjeldor became part of New Argive, and the desert emerged again.
events.quote: During the Thaw , the ice melted away, and Kjeldor became part of New Argive .

relations.quote: The city of Toribah is located in the desert.
